(1) a multi encoder LSTM model can handle multiple features simultaneously to predict relations in a given text; (2) a confidence based filtering technique can improve the performance of a relation extraction system by removing noisy alignments.

(1) We propose a novel multi-encoder LSTM network to identify relations in text, (2) We propose a technique to compute confidence levels of relations automatically, and (3) We show that our model can learn intermediate representations effectively to predict relations.

(a) a multi encoder LSTM model can effectively handle different types of features (b) the model can learn effective intermediate representation of a sentence to identify relations (c) confidence levels can be computed to improve performance of relation extraction models and (d) the multi encoder LSTM model with confidence levels can outperform state of the art relation extraction models.
